## Activity

During May 2025, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 103 captures. This level of activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The results should be considered alongside the quality findings below to support routine monitoring of site operations.

## Image quality

Of the images submitted, 6 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.8. These results should be reviewed as part of the site’s routine quality monitoring. The clinic lead has requested that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that any persistent problems can be identified and followed up through the appropriate process.

## Grading

Grading identified 19 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This provides a summary measure of turnaround for the month and should be considered with the volume of captures and the image-quality findings. Continued attention to camera performance and timely logging of recurring issues will support reliable capture and grading at Hill Counties Health Centre.
